description: Subventions Ile-de-France Mobilités is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Liste des subventions signées/notifiées par Ile-de-France Mobilités. Ce fichier répond à une norme fixée par le Décret no 2017-779 du 5 mai 2017 relatif à l’accès sous forme électronique aux données essentielles des conventions de subvention. Vous trouverez ce décret en pièce jointe. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Infrastructures. Its keywords are Projets, Collectivité. The portal shows 2019-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
